parameters.content:
## Enable Banking Token Renewal (spec 005 section 4.2.1)
Code nodes may use external modules (jsonwebtoken) but NOT node built-ins (fs/https/crypto) -
every network call is an HTTP Request node and JWTs are signed with jsonwebtoken.
The k8s calls authorize with the Header Auth credential holding the n8n ServiceAccount token
(Role n8n-finance-secrets: get on both finance Secrets, create/patch the token one).

- Daily: valid_until within 3 days (or token Secret missing) -> Slack #workflows nudge
- Form page 1 -> account dropdown built from accounts.json -> POST /auth -> redirect to the bank
- Bank redirect -> /webhook/enablebanking-consent?code=... -> POST /sessions -> upsert finance-enablebanking-token
Whitelist https://automation-n8n.homelab.alvsanand.com/webhook/enablebanking-consent on the application.

nodes.name: Daily Check
nodes.notes: Before the 06:00 finance DAG so a renewal decided today is in place by ingest time.

nodes.name: Get Stable Secret
nodes.notes: allowUnauthorizedCerts is scoped to the in-cluster kubernetes.default.svc endpoint

nodes.name: Get Token Secret
nodes.notes: allowUnauthorizedCerts is scoped to the in-cluster kubernetes.default.svc endpoint; 404 is the expected 'Secret not created yet' state

nodes.name: Healthy, No Action
nodes.notes: Fires on healthy days; keeps the false branch explicit.

parameters.formDescription: Step 1 of 3 - continue to choose the account. Then you log in at your bank (the only manual step); the token Secret updates automatically afterwards.

values.html: The bank login on the next step is the one manual PSD2 step. When you approve, the tokens Secret is updated automatically.

nodes.name: Get Stable Secret - Form
nodes.notes: allowUnauthorizedCerts is scoped to the in-cluster kubernetes.default.svc endpoint

options.formDescription: Step 2 of 3 - pick the account whose consent you are renewing, then Submit. The next screen is your bank's login and approval page.

nodes.name: Form: Select Account
nodes.notes: dropdown values are built from finance-enablebanking.accounts.json, so a new account needs only a Secret entry

nodes.name: Get Stable Secret - Webhook
nodes.notes: allowUnauthorizedCerts is scoped to the in-cluster kubernetes.default.svc endpoint

nodes.name: Get Token Secret - Webhook
nodes.notes: allowUnauthorizedCerts is scoped to the in-cluster kubernetes.default.svc endpoint; 404 is the expected 'Secret not created yet' state

nodes.name: Create Token Secret
nodes.notes: the renewal-owned token Secret was deleted or never created (Get returned 404)
